intro.title: About Nomad in Thailand
intro.p1: "Nomad in Thailand" is a community media for Japanese digital nomads in their 20s to 40s who are based in, or aiming to move to, Thailand.
intro.p2: We specialize in providing "essential information for moving and staying", ranging from practical topics like visas, taxes, and housing to real local lifestyle information.

media_power.title: Media Features
media_power.audience_desc: Primarily IT-literate individuals in their 20s and 30s who are active in seeking new work styles and life abroad.
media_power.engagement_desc: Read by users who are "seriously considering moving/staying", not just casual browsers.
media_power.trust_desc: The operators live locally, ensuring the freshness and reliability of the information.

plans.title: Advertising & Partnership Plans

listing.title: Premium Company Listing
